metadata.title: What Does 'Fragrance' on a Label Actually Mean? | Tide
metadata.description: Learn what 'fragrance' means on laundry product labels, why fragrance blends are listed under a single term, how fragrance ingredients are evaluated for safety, and where consumers can find additional ingredient transparency.
